notes.title: Thanks to you, the game continues: VIP Pass offered as a thank you!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

It is with great pleasure that I announce we have reached the necessary amount to[b] fund the servers for another year![/b] [h3]Thanks to your support[/h3]
We can continue to keep this game alive and offer a better experience to the entire community.

As a token of our appreciation, I am happy to offer you all a [b]VIP Pass[/b], which will be available in the coming months. This pass will give you access to free skins, a custom icon, and many other perks, including a special rank on our Discord server, and much more.

I sincerely thank you for your commitment.

You can join our Discord server via the link below to chat directly with me and discover the upcoming new features.
[url=https://discord.gg/fdpY8Jq7H3]Discord[/url]

Lamondille
CEO of Cyberstorm
